title: Work with Unnie Note
description: Sponsored stories in nine languages and travel guide partnerships for brands that want to reach young fans of Korean culture abroad. Rankings are never for sale.
lead: We help Korean brands, places and services reach young fans of Korean culture abroad, in their own language and always clearly labelled.
languages: languages, written for fans of Korean culture in their teens to thirties, mostly reading on their phones
audienceLead: Each edition is written for readers in these places.

packages.name: Sponsored story in nine languages
packages.line: We write one story about your product, place or event in our own voice and publish it in all nine languages. It stays on the site and sits in the home page rail for one week.
includes: Written and translated by our editorial team
One week in the home page rail
Links marked as sponsored for search engines

packages.name: Travel guide partnership
packages.line: For tours, passes, eSIMs and stays for visitors to Korea: your booking link can appear in the “Before you go” box on our travel guides.
includes: Shown with an Ad label and our disclosure line
Order set by what suits readers of each language, not by commission

notForSale: We don't sell ranking, award or chart spots. A paying partner never changes an order or a score.
never: Hospital or clinic advertising, sponsored clinic stories or clinic affiliate links
Paid reviews, testimonials or “I tried it” stories
Paid positions in our rankings, awards or K-pop charts
Sponsored content without a label, or labels hidden in comments or “more” menus
contact: Tell us about your brand and what you have in mind. Every message is read by a person on our team.
contactPending: Our partnership email is being set up. Until then, please reach us through the <contact>contact page</contact>.
